'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Lollo Logistic NPC found with a student, '''Baugh'''.

==Location==
<gallery>File:NPC Davin and Baug location.png</gallery>

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Davin:''' Once I'm done with these last few deliveries, I'll be leaving Lahai-Roi.

:'''Baug:''' Why the sudden departure... Are you heading back home to get married or something?

:'''Davin:''' Isn't this joke a bit too old for you? Of course, not... I requested a transfer to another region.

:'''Davin:''' In a strange new place, wandering through the streets and alleyways, or flying down the highway, making new friends and taking in new sights.

:'''Davin:''' I arrived as a stranger, but by the time I leave, this will be a place I'll forever miss. I've really enjoyed this journey.

:'''Baug:''' You couldn't even find your way around the place when you first got here... I remember the way you were panicking like it was yesterday. Was that also part of the enjoyment of the process?

:'''Davin:''' Haha, I really would've been left sleeping on the streets without you. Now I know my way around like the back of my hand... That's all part of enjoying the journey, don't you think?

:'''Baug:''' Give me a heads up before you head out... I'll walk you to the Starward Riseway.

:'''Davin:''' You know, I've been meaning to say this for a while... You're way too mature for a student.
{{Dialogue End}}
